text: だけど…　わがままで　イヤんなっちゃうよ

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the short spoken form of てしまう, which says something ends up happening, often when you don't want it to. なっちゃう = 'I end up getting'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に plus なる means to become that way; here に is slurred to ん in fast speech. イヤんなっちゃう = 'I end up getting fed up'.

patterns.name: 〜で (reason)
patterns.explanation: で after a describing word like わがまま joins it to what follows and gives the reason for it. わがままで = 'she's selfish, and so'.
